name: Dave Bronson
summary: David Bronson (born June 26, 1958) is an American politician, pilot, and retired National Guard (Air Force) officer. A Republican, he was the 37th mayor of Anchorage, Alaska, from 2021 until 2024. Bronson was a candidate in the 2026 Alaska gubernatorial election.
